purpose: Teach: 希少/翻弄/養殖/押し寄せ/異変/地質/学説/真偽

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 希少な人材、本気で、当社に、絶対、引き止めろ、絶対、頼んだぞ、本気で、本当に、頼んだぞ、絶対。
lines.en: Rare talent like this — we have to hold onto them. Absolutely. I'm counting on you. Seriously.
lines.style: Urgent, commanding. Sharp attack on 'Rare talent.' Repetition is not emphasis — it's urgency buried under control. Clipped sentences. The weight of responsibility, not anger.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。市場の波に翻弄されない経営、本気で、目指してまいります、絶対、お父さんの代から、変わらず、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We're committed to management that isn't swayed by market trends. Absolutely. That's been true since my father's time, and it still is.
lines.style: Steady, respectful. Measured pace. Lean into the continuity — 'my father's time' with quiet pride. Confident without being presumptuous. Ground the promises in history.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新規事業、養殖関連、本気で、検討中だ、絶対、若手、頑張ってもらいたい、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、絶対。
lines.en: We're exploring new ventures in aquaculture. Seriously. I need the younger staff to really step up. Make it happen.
lines.style: Direct, expectant. Crisp opening. Strategic pauses before demands. Not harsh — matter-of-fact authority. The tone of someone used to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。注文、本気で、押し寄せてきております、絶対、生産、間に合わせます、社員、本気で、頑張ります、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. Orders are pouring in. We'll meet the deadlines. Our staff is going to do everything it takes.
lines.style: Steady, assured. Quiet confidence. No hesitation — just facts delivered with backbone. Pace is even. Protecting his team and the company in one breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の異変、本気で、敏感に、察知しろ、絶対、当社、対応、急がせろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、これは、絶対だ。
lines.en: Watch for shifts in the industry. Be sensitive to them. We have to respond fast. No delays. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Sharp, deliberate. Each sentence a separate command. Slight emphasis on 'fast' and 'no delays' — not shouted, but unmissable. The tone shifts from strategic to protective.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新地質調査結果、本気で、参考に、新事業、本当に、進めてまいります、絶対、本気で、頑張ります、絶対、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The new geological survey results — we're using them as a foundation for the new business. We'll move forward. Absolutely.
lines.style: Focused, purposeful. Anchor on 'geological survey results' — they're evidence, not guesswork. Steady hands on the wheel. End with quiet certainty, not repetition.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新しい経営学説、本気で、勉強しろ、社員、皆、絶対、視野、広げろ、本気で、頼んだぞ、絶対、これは、本当に、本気。
lines.en: Study new management theory. All of you. Expand your perspective. I need your minds sharp. This matters.
lines.style: Teaching, not lecturing. Open up on 'Expand your perspective' — give them room to grow. Conviction underneath — this is an investment in them, not a burden.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。情報の真偽、社員、本気で、見極める力、育てていきます、絶対、本気で、教育、続けてまいります、絶対、頼みます。
lines.en: Yes. We're building our team's ability to discern truth from falsehood. We'll keep learning. We'll keep improving.
lines.style: Humble, grounded. No urgency or performance — just steady promise. The smaller, quieter version of a commitment. Ends softly, like a door closing gently behind a decision made.
